purpose: Second batch of public LangGraph/LangChain failures for validation. ACR007-ACR009 were designed on batch 1; batch 2 was not used for rule design.

cases.title: map-reduce InvalideUpdateError
cases.selection_reason: Classic map-reduce fan-out/fan-in graph; a list-valued state field turns into str and raises InvalidUpdateError - direct ACR002-style parallel write conflict.

cases.title: Sink node issue, if multiple subgraphs are used in parallel
cases.selection_reason: Multiple subgraphs run in parallel into a sink node; replacing subgraphs with plain nodes makes it work - subgraph output boundary / shared-state case (ACR001/ACR003).

cases.title: Fan-out/in fails with subgraphs
cases.selection_reason: Send-based fan-out into subgraphs then merge back into the parent state fails; works when the fan-out targets a parent function - subgraph state merge/output-schema case.

cases.title: Subgraphs channels reducer updating out of turn
cases.selection_reason: Two sibling subgraphs share the parent state key behind a counting reducer; reducer fires out of turn across supersteps - parallel subgraph reducer semantics (ACR001/ACR002).

cases.title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Invalid update for channel medical with values
cases.selection_reason: Concrete InvalidUpdateError for a channel written twice in one step, with graph code; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

cases.title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Can receive only one value per step. Use an Annotated key to handle multiple values. error when running retry in graph parallel processing
cases.selection_reason: Parallel branches plus a conditional retry edge on one branch produce 'Can receive only one value per step' - parallel + retry composition (ACR002/ACR005-adjacent).

cases.title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Must write to at least one of ['input', 'plan', 'past_steps', 'response']
cases.selection_reason: Long plan-and-execute thread; a node returns no declared keys and raises InvalidUpdateError 'Must write to at least one of ...' - state schema / node return contract (ACR007-adjacent).

cases.title: Subgraph with private state doesn't have a proper state at the last node
cases.selection_reason: Double-nested subgraphs with private state; the innermost graph's last node returns parent-private keys and errors - private state / nested output schema composition.

cases.title: PrivateState not working if the node is activated by a Send object
cases.selection_reason: PrivateState stops working when the node is activated by Send - Send + private schema interaction.

cases.title: Default value of state variable not working with reducer function
cases.selection_reason: Default value on an Annotated reducer field is not applied - reducer/default initialization semantics; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

cases.title: Update state fails when resuming subgraph after interrupt
cases.selection_reason: State update/persistence behavior when resuming a subgraph after interrupt - subgraph resume + state update ordering.

cases.title: Remote Subgraph (using interrupt) not resuming
cases.selection_reason: RemoteGraph subgraph containing interrupt does not resume after Command(resume=...); self-contained repro with langgraph dev.

cases.title: 【Command】：Can't use update and List[Send] at the same time if graph==Command.PARENT
cases.selection_reason: Combining Command(update=...) with a list of Send under Command.PARENT - routing/update composition; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

cases.title: LangChain messages casted to BaseMessage when passed to subgraph via Send arg
cases.selection_reason: LangChain message objects passed to a subgraph via Send arg are cast to BaseMessage, breaking the child node's type expectation.

cases.title: Passing private state with Class Node
cases.selection_reason: Private state used with a class-based node fails with 'must write to global state' while the documented function-node version works - node declaration/output contract (ACR007-adjacent).

cases.title: How can parallel nodes send a param value to the same downstream node ? the downstream node needs to adapt the param value based on which parallel upstream node called it
cases.summary: Two parallel branches call the same downstream save-file helper and need to know which branch they came from. A list reducer merges both branch updates out of order, while removing the reducer raises InvalidUpdateError at key 'last_tool'.
cases.notes: State snippet included; no accepted answer. Directly exercises parallel-write/reducer reasoning (ACR002-adjacent) plus branch-identity ambiguity; strong fixture candidate.
cases.selection_reason: community candidate selected for validation

cases.title: Does LangGraph support using HITL within subgraphs?
cases.summary: interrupt() inside a subgraph invoked from a parent node appears not to pause. The snippet lacks a checkpointer/thread_id, mixes the interrupt payload with the resume value, and misses END edges; the reply lists the required HITL mechanics and notes that function-invoked subgraphs restart on resume.
cases.notes: Full snippet; the answer identifies several usage errors. Good parallel-interrupt/resume fixture seed if framed as user-graph misuse rather than a framework bug.
cases.selection_reason: community candidate selected for validation

cases.title: State is not being copied between sub-graphs
cases.summary: A subgraph hands off to the next subgraph with Command.PARENT, but updates accumulated earlier in the same stream are missing; only the Command(update=...) payload reaches the parent. The reply says this is expected: state crosses a subgraph boundary only via the returned update.
cases.notes: Contains State and Command snippets; maintainer-style reply confirms the behavior, so this is a state-design/handoff issue rather than a framework bug. Relevant to Command/Send + subgraph boundary gaps.
cases.selection_reason: community candidate selected for validation

cases.title: The conditional edge in LangGraph causes the reduce function to be invoked twice
cases.summary: A looping conditional edge makes an Annotated list reducer append each Fibonacci value twice; the OP expects one reducer call per node update. A full runnable snippet with expected-vs-actual output is included.
cases.notes: Full code and observed duplicate values; no answer. Root cause unconfirmed (could be conditional-edge write semantics), so verify before labeling it framework vs usage. Directly targets reducer double-application.
cases.selection_reason: community candidate selected for validation

cases.title: LangGraph KeyError: when embedding a compiled subgraph node in a parent graph workflow
cases.summary: Registering a compiled subgraph as parent node 'scheduler_assistant' and routing to that node from START raises KeyError: 'scheduler_assistant' inside LangGraph routing. The post includes a minimal structure and the traceback.
cases.notes: Concrete KeyError plus code fragments; may be a node-name/routing bug on 0.5.x/0.6.7 or graph-construction misuse — unresolved. Good candidate for subgraph-registration diagnostics.
cases.selection_reason: community candidate selected for validation
